text:
jen: Heads-up — we need a minimal hotfix bump for 1.12.x. kvcache regression showed up in prod, rolling back a small change is safest. Target cut in ~2h unless someone objects.

sahil: I can cut the branch and open the PR. plan: branch from stable, apply the tiny revert, run smoke, then tag. :thumbsup:

alex: OK. Which file is the revert? I saw a one-line change in storage/kvcache/cache_manager.go.

jen: correct — revert is basically this block:
```
- if prefetchAllowed && keyPrefetchSize > 0 {
-    prefetch(key)
- }
+ // revert: disable prefetch until patch lands
```
should be a single-line revert, minimal diff.

marie: Will CI catch any perf regressions? unit + smoke covered, but long-run perf tests are slow. For hotfix we only need smoke + canary.

alex: Good. I'll review once PR is up. Sahil, ping me for quick review, I can take it immediately.

sahil: Doing it now. Branch name: `hotfix/1.12.5-kvcache-revert`. Steps:
1) `git checkout -b hotfix/1.12.5-kvcache-revert stable`
2) apply revert
3) push + open PR targeting stable
4) run smoke job and quick canary deploy to staging

jen: changelog nudge: add a single line under "bug fixes" — explain kvcache prefetch regression and that we reverted prefetch. Keep wording minimal. I'll handle the blurb if you want to focus on branch.

sahil: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4723 — awaiting review. CI started.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for PR #4723 — jobs: unit-tests, lint, smoke.

alex: Reviewing now. Quick note: watch for the kv eviction test flake, might be unrelated.

marie: I'll queue the canary once CI passes. Suggest canary on one replica in us-west before tagging.

jen: timeline check: if CI passes in ~20m and review quick, we can tag + cut at T+90m. If anything blocks, fallback is to revert the original revert and rollback the canary.

sahil: CI green. Addressed a lint nit. @alex still needs approval.

alex: Approved, merging in 2.

sahil: Merged and pushed tag `v1.12.5` to stable. Triggered release pipeline.

deploy-bot: Release pipeline started for tag v1.12.5 — smoke canary deploying to staging-us-west-1.

marie: Canary looks good after 10m smoke (no increased error rate, latency within baseline). Proceeding to prod canary.

jen: Great. Once prod canary stable for 15m, we'll flip traffic. Thanks everyone. Short changelog blurb added to release notes. :tada:
